decisions.reason: The buzzer package and supported-voltage details do not change the independently specified LED power or data interface.
The source selects a prototype buzzer and does not alter the LED array board's LED part, package, dimensions, mounting, or count.
The buzzer selection does not change the sensor-board connector matrix or board role.
The buzzer specifications do not affect the panel reset connector or its electrical action.
The buzzer selection does not alter any panel button, switch, GPIO, or connector requirement.
The passive buzzer part does not change the independently required PIR input connector.
The buzzer's voltage listing is incidental and does not alter the SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
The buzzer selection does not change the capacitive-touch sensors, connectors, or GPIO assignments.
Listing the buzzer's supported voltages does not necessarily change which system rails are monitored or the current-monitor topology.
The prototype buzzer choice does not alter the AXP2101 power-management architecture or required system rails.
The buzzer part listing does not establish any change to standalone USB power capacity, regulator selection, or powered loads.
Selecting a prototype buzzer does not change the three-board architecture or the defined roles of the main and sensor boards.
